english.title: Make a false statement to procure police permit under section 7 of the Firearms Act 1968 for a firearm / ammunition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) for the purpose of procuring for

(A)_[yourself]_
(B)_[another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_

the grant of a police permit under section 7 of the Firearms Act 1968 to possess a firearm and ammunition, namely **(..SPECIFY FIREARM / AMMUNITION..), knowingly or recklessly made a statement which was false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE PARTICULAR..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7(2) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Due to amendments made by Schedule 5 to the Crime and Policing Act 2026, this applies to offences committed before 29th June 2026. For the offence applying on or after that date see H102817.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
